purpose: Planning record for one installed polymer heating-cycle temperature chain; not an executable processing request.

measurand.target_location_and_coordinate_frame: Proposed coupon-centred coordinates; thermocouple junction 1 mm below the heated face; as-installed survey required.
measurand.spatial_averaging_convention: Local sensing-junction result; effective sensing volume and spatial gradient correction require characterization.
measurand.time_origin_and_averaging_convention: Proposed acquisition-clock origin at first indicated 323.15 K crossing; retain unsmoothed samples and arrival times.
measurand.instrumented_or_undisturbed_polymer_targ: Instrumented specimen local polymer temperature; undisturbed-material temperature is outside the initial claim.
measurand.optional_model_output_target: Proposed same local instrumented-polymer temperature; no core or field reconstruction in the initial comparison.

measurement_chain.raw_quantity_and_unit: Proposed MAX31855 indicated temperature after internal thermocouple conversion, explicitly converted to K; retain original acquisition bytes and fault flags. Subsequent affine correction is not global EMF linearization.

installation_method_and_drawing.published_arrangement: Epoxy-fixed subsurface junction; opposite face on steel support

reference_instrument_and_calibration_cha.proposed_method: Independent calibrated reference; controlled-bath comparison informed by NIST thermocouple service

acquisition_clock_and_alignment.proposed_method: Preserve device sequence, acquisition timestamp and host arrival timestamp; independently measure latency and clock drift

measurement_chain.original_acquisition_record_retention: Proposed immutable original-byte retention with content hashes, acquisition metadata and fault records; normalized MCP declarations remain separately identified.
measurement_chain.authentication_contract_if_required: Origin authentication is not established; define signed acquisition separately if required by the pilot recipient.

operating_envelope.allowed_installations_devices_and_operat: Proposed claim restricted to one identified chain and installation; no device-family generalization.
operating_envelope.missing_and_saturation_policy: Retain acquisition faults and missing samples; never replace observations with estimates; numerical acceptance remains indeterminate when required observations are unavailable.

acceptance_criteria.customer_decision_and_specification: Provisional research targets chosen for planning; no customer acceptance agreement or demonstrated performance is implied.

coverage_convention_probability_and_fact.basis: Planning target only; distribution and achieved coverage must be justified experimentally

bias_and_error_limits_K.status: Design targets only; reference uncertainty must enter the comparison

acceptance_criteria.reference_comparison_rule: Proposed matched-location/time differences with reference uncertainty and covariance; independently require maximum uncertainty and bias limits.
acceptance_criteria.operational_accept_reject_indeterminate_: Proposed closed uncertainty-interval containment at submitted instants only; physical qualification and between-sample excursions remain separate.

pinn_gpinn_improvement_or_noninferiority.planned_rule: Freeze a cycle-level noninferiority margin after preliminary variance estimates and before held-out outcomes

experiment_design.static_comparison_points_and_sequences: Proposed 323.15, 338.15 and 353.15 K controlled-bath comparisons in both directions, plus before/after checks; characterize the complete readout channel.
experiment_design.dynamic_profiles_and_conditions: Proposed slow heating with separately recorded intermittent cooling; record actual rate, ambient, placement and reference response. Do not adopt literature transient averages as instantaneous bounds.
experiment_design.replication_across_days_installations_op: Proposed independent specimens/cycles across days and reinstallations; cross operators where feasible. Choose counts after preliminary variance estimation.
experiment_design.randomization_and_blocking: Proposed day/installation blocks with randomized feasible profile order; preserve specimen thermal history.

development_tuning_and_confirmatory_spli.planned_grouping: Keep specimen and whole cycle together; reserve complete days/installations for confirmatory assessment where feasible

experiment_design.additional_held_out_day_lot_installation: Proposed held-out days and reinstallations for the single-chain claim; additional lots require a separately supported claim.
experiment_design.within_envelope_validation_conditions: Proposed interior and endpoint temperature/rate conditions with uncertainty-aware independent reference comparisons.
experiment_design.separate_ood_stress_conditions: Proposed rates beyond the declared envelope, changed contact/placement, drift, missingness and saturation; require unsupported/indeterminate behaviour.

independent_instrument_or_laboratory_com.proposed_route: Independent calibrated reference and, where feasible, external laboratory comparison

resolution_noise_drift_hysteresis.required_effects: Readout quantization, noise, cold-junction compensation, internal linearization, fit residual, drift and hysteresis

apparatus_reference.source_locator: Methods and Table 3; rate unit follows surrounding prose

reference_method.published_capability: SPRT bath comparison; expanded uncertainty 0.1 K at 90 degrees Celsius
reference_method.limitation: Service capability is not this pilot's calibration, installed uncertainty or a transferred certificate

proposed_not_source_measurements.temperature_and_rate_envelopes: Selected candidate window around the published case; instantaneous rate coverage is unestablished
proposed_not_source_measurements.required_uncertainty_and_error_limits: Engineering research targets, informed by readout resolution and reference capability; not published achieved uncertainties or customer-agreed criteria
proposed_not_source_measurements.timing_and_position_targets: Proposed design tolerances; no achieved timing or placement evidence
proposed_not_source_measurements.calibration_points: Proposed coverage of the pilot window; no measurements performed

dataset_suitability.not_usable_as: Independent confirmatory dataset or traceability chain
gaps: No machine-readable raw-data link located in the inspected paper
No reference certificate or complete installed uncertainty established
Air-cycle timing and independent heat input are insufficient for a bounded physics-informed validation dataset
dataset_suitability.current_software_limit: Published duration and sampling imply about 1500 observations; affine processing admits at most 64 per request. Preserve complete cycles externally; do not silently truncate, downsample or claim covariance across independent windows.

source_selection.retention: Paraphrased facts and primary-source links only; no paper PDF or figure redistribution
